daily.title: Daily report
daily.subtitle: A day's first punch is the check-in and the last one the check-out. Arriving after the phone line opens (office phone hours, usually {{start}}) counts as late.
daily.label: One day's attendance

monthly.title: Monthly report
monthly.subtitle: Days present, hours and lateness per person. Arriving after the phone line opens (office phone hours, usually {{start}}) counts as late; its closed days are not absences.
monthly.label: One month's attendance

settings.title: Attendance settings
settings.subtitle: Connect each device number to an employee so the hours are counted under their name.
settings.label: Device numbers
settings.unmapped: {{n}} numbers are not connected to an employee. Their punches count for nobody.
settings.error: That did not work. Try again.
settings.readNamesAsked: Requested. The names are read the next time the device connects.
